title: SGD with Large Learning Rates: General Analysis & Improved Rates
abstract: arXiv:2611.32762v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stochastic Gradient Descent lies at the core of modern machine learning. However its classical analysis typically restricts the stepsize to be below a curvature-dependent stability threshold. Recent developments in deterministic optimization have challenged this paradigm, showing that suitably chosen large stepsizes can not only preserve convergence, but also accelerate Gradient Descent (GD). Whether this phenomenon persists in the presence of stochastic gradient noise has remained an open question (Wu et al., 2024). In this work, we answer this question affirmatively for the cross-entropy loss with linear predictors and two-layer neural networks, establishing an accelerated $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2})$ convergence rate. At the core of our analysis is a fine-grained characterization of the stochastic large-stepsize dynamics. translated_title: 大学习率下的随机梯度下降：一般性分析与改进的收敛速率
translated_abstract: 随机梯度下降（SGD）是现代机器学习的核心。然而，其经典分析通常将步长限制在低于一个依赖于曲率的稳定性阈值以下。确定性优化领域的最新进展挑战了这一范式，表明适当选择的大步长不仅可以保持收敛性，还能加速梯度下降（GD）。这一现象在存在随机梯度噪声的情况下是否仍然成立，一直是一个悬而未决的问题（Wu et al., 2024）。在本工作中，我们对带有线性预测器的交叉熵损失以及两层神经网络肯定地回答了这一问题，建立了加速的 $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2})$ 收敛速率。我们分析的核心是对随机大步长动力学的细粒度刻画。这种对轨迹更精确的控制进一步在稳定区域内给出了紧致的收敛保证，改进了……
tldr: 本文证明了大学习率的SGD在随机梯度噪声存在下仍能加速收敛，对线性预测器的交叉熵损失和两层神经网络建立了加速的O(T^-2)收敛速率，并在稳定区域内给出了更紧致的收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper affirmatively shows that SGD with suitably chosen large learning rates can accelerate convergence even under stochastic gradient noise, establishing an accelerated O(T^-2) rate for cross-entropy loss with linear predictors and two-layer neural networks, along with tighter convergence guarantees in the stable regime.
